name: theme
title: Theme
description: p0seid0n design tokens: the nine --p0seid0n-* colours, control and panel radii, popup shadow, motion curves and durations, keyframes, and the Tailwind v4 @theme inline bridge.

name: theme-shadcn
title: Theme (shadcn aliases)
description: Optional compatibility stylesheet mapping standard shadcn CSS variables and Tailwind v4 colour tokens onto --p0seid0n-* variables.

name: utils
title: Utils
description: The cn() class merge helper built on clsx and tailwind-merge.

name: button
title: Button
description: Ink-filled primary, control-grey secondary, transparent ghost and danger button in three sizes, with loading and leading/trailing slots.

name: badge
title: Badge
description: Small labelling chip in neutral, accent, accent-alt and outline variants.

name: separator
title: Separator
description: One-pixel rule in a line colour, horizontal or vertical.

name: card
title: Card
description: Panel container with a raised or surface appearance, plus header, content and footer sections.

name: input
title: Input
description: Text field with a focus ring, an aria-driven invalid state and a disabled state.

name: label
title: Label
description: Caption that associates with a control through its for attribute, with an optional required marker.

name: switch
title: Switch
description: Two-state control built on reka-ui, in md and lg sizes with an optional slot inside the thumb.

name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
description: Menu root, trigger and popup with plain, checkbox and radio items, labels, separators and groups.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Delayed hover and focus hint with four sides and an optional shortcut hint.

name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: Centered modal with overlay, title, description and a built-in close control.

name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Trigger strip and panels with arrow key navigation.

name: toast
title: Toast
description: Self-contained notification stack with a provider, useToast composable and three variants.

name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: Hand-written SVG bar strip for a numeric series, with median-based scaling and an optional baseline.

name: stat
title: Stat
description: Label, condensed tabular value and unit, with an inline figure slot for a sparkline.

name: theme-provider
title: Theme Provider
description: Three-state theme state (system, light, dark) with a matching inline script for the first paint.

name: theme-switcher
title: Theme Switcher
description: Ghost button opening a radio menu with system, light and dark choices.
